component.name: Romlens
component.summary: Read a Super NES ROM: disassembly, C, graphics and sound

description.p: Romlens is a workbench for studying Super NES ROMs. It disassembles the 65816 code, lifts routines to C, draws the graphics and plays the sound with an emulated SPC700 and DSP, and keeps your names and comments in a project you can save.

An optional tutor answers questions about the ROM you have open. It reads Romlens's own analysis and cites addresses and frames you can click. It needs an API key for a provider you choose, or a model served on your own machine, and sends nothing until you ask a question.
Romlens never ships or fetches a ROM. Open one you own.
First release of the Linux shell.
